works.description: 透過細緻的手工縫製，讓光線在布料的皺摺間變化，創造層次豐富的視覺效果。燈光穿透皺褶肌理，形成柔和且有趣的光影，為空間增添獨特氛圍。
works.longDescription:
皺摺紋理不僅承載了傳統工藝的溫度，也是時間在布料上的刻畫，為展現日式工藝美學與現代極簡設計的融合，帶有自然紋理與侘寂美學的「手作感」和「時間流逝的痕跡」的概念。

在手工縫製與光影的交互作用下，透過光的投射形成流動般的視覺效果，既增強視覺層次感，又賦予作品動態與觸感美感，讓靜態的材質擁有動態的生命力。
works.english: Through delicate hand stitching, light changes within the folds of the fabric, creating a layered visual effect. The light penetrates the textured pleats, forming soft and intriguing shadows that add a unique atmosphere to the space.
works.english_detail:
The pleated texture carries the warmth of traditional craftsmanship and the passage of time, blending Japanese craft aesthetics with modern minimalism. 

The projection creates a flowing visual effect through hand stitching and light, adding depth, dynamic beauty, and a tactile sense, giving static material life.

title.sub: 光與香氣重塑空間的感知
title.sub_en: Light and fragrance redefine the perception of space

works.description: 融合光影、氣味與材質的水泥香氛吊燈，為居住空間帶來感官體驗。水泥的穩重與都市感，在剛與柔之間取得和諧平衡，讓燈不僅是照明工具，更是感知生活的媒介。
works.longDescription:
水泥具吸水性又有氣孔的特性，正好符合擴香的特性，能夠吸附液態的精油再釋放香氣。利用其特性，並結合了燈具創造出滿足嗅覺及視覺的療癒體驗。將光、氣味與材質結合，創造出一種能夠激發感官共鳴的家居體驗。

透過建築材料－水泥與光的搭配加上氣味，詮釋居住空間的個性。結合現代風格和實用性，讓風格燈具多一種感官體驗
works.english: The cement-scented pendant light blends light, scent, and texture, offering a unique and immersive sensory experience. Its solid, urban feel beautifully balances rigidity and softness, making it not just for illumination but also a medium for experiencing life.
works.english_detail:
Cement’s absorbent and porous nature makes it ideal for diffusing essential oils. Combined with lighting, it creates a therapeutic experience for sight and smell. 

This blend of light, scent, and texture enhances a space’s personality, merging modern style with practicality.
